purpose: Form INC-4 is filed to notify the Registrar of the withdrawal of a nominee's consent and the intimation of a new person nominated by the sole member of a One Person Company.
when: Within thirty days of receipt of the notice of withdrawal of consent
steps: Receive a notice of withdrawal in writing from the nominated person.
The sole member nominates another person within fifteen days of receiving the withdrawal notice.
Obtain the written consent and declaration of the new nominee.
File Form INC-4 with the Registrar within thirty days of receiving the notice of withdrawal.
checklist: Notice of withdrawal in writing from the previous nominee
Written consent of the newly nominated person
Declaration of the newly nominated person in Form INC-4
Fee as provided in the Companies (Registration offices and fees) Rules, 2014
attachments: Written consent of the newly nominated person
Declaration of the newly nominated person
watch: Not stated in the Rules text
